title: Conference Board Consumer Confidence Index (January 2027), 10:00 a.m. ET
source: EST: conference-board.org/topics/consumer-confidence fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200, 332,031 bytes after one 301), the publisher's own August-2026 release page, which states the standing rule in prose: "The Conference Board publishes the Consumer Confidence Index (R) at 10 a.m. ET on the last Tuesday of every month." 2027-01-26 is the last Tuesday of January 2027. The same page names its next release as "Tuesday, September 29th at 10 AM ET", the corresponding last Tuesday, corroborating the rule against a dated instance. No January-2027 announcement exists yet, so this is the publisher's rule applied forward rather than a posted date — filed estimate on that basis as well as this lane's no-self-confirm limit on an event discovered in-sweep. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the fhfa-hpi-2027-01-26 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06), on the same feed-the-calendar precedent by which the proposer itself was proposed one edition earlier. It is proposed for one concrete reason rather than bookkeeping: it is the proposer's central confound. Every one of the 68 FHFA release days measured since 2021 is also a Conference Board day, because both publishers key to the last Tuesday — so no daily-bar design can ever attribute a move to the FHFA print. The two are an HOUR apart in print (FHFA 9:00 ET per its own 2026Q2 report appendix; the Conference Board 10:00 ET per the page cited above), which names the only design that could work — a 9:00-10:00 ET window — and is why the confound is worth a calendar slot rather than a footnote. Note for whoever researches it: 2027-01-26 is also FOMC day one (the Fed's own calendar gives January 26-27, 2027) and sits inside fomc-blackout-start-2027-01-16, so this print lands in front of a decision rather than in a quiet slot — the January Consumer Confidence reading is the last consumer datapoint the Committee sees before it votes. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
